profile: Project management and advisory consultant with six years coordinating complex multi-stakeholder initiatives across NGOs, a DAX-listed group and B2B advisory clients. Builds consolidated project plans and trackers, maps dependencies across workstreams, and carries risks, actions and decisions to closure through structured reporting and lessons-learned review. Steered a cross-functional team spanning Compliance, Risk, Legal, IT and supply chain at TUI AG, taking a regulatory programme into operation across international subsidiaries and tracking completion entity by entity.

experience.title: LCA & Sustainability Consultant (Contract)
bullets: Advise B2B clients as an independent contractor, determining the methodology, tools and delivery approach for each engagement and reporting progress against agreed milestones
Monitor EU and national policy developments and translate each obligation into implementation roadmaps carrying named owners, deadlines and the evidence required to close it
Pilot new compliance and data-collection processes on a single client and product line, then extend them across the wider portfolio once the approach holds
Quantify the commercial impact of regulation by modelling market-by-market fee exposure in Excel, so decisions rest on figures rather than estimates

experience.title: Sustainability Strategy and Stakeholder Dialogue (Work Study)
bullets: Built and steered a cross-functional project team across Compliance, Risk, Legal, IT and supply chain, setting deliverables, mapping dependencies between workstreams and holding contributors to deadlines without line authority
Coordinated a regulatory rollout directly with international group subsidiaries, maintaining the planning trackers, action logs and completion records behind entity-by-entity progress
Reported status, emerging risks and outstanding actions to senior leadership, with recommendations on where alignment across functions and regions needed correcting
Assessed delivery and supply chain risks against severity and likelihood thresholds, and put forward the mitigation measures that went into the implementation plan
Wrote the process documentation, work instructions and decision-rights splits defining who owned each requirement across functions and entities

experience.title: Disclosures (Work Study)
bullets: Served as primary point of contact for 150+ organisations globally, resolving methodology, reporting-requirement and deadline queries across a full disclosure cycle
Supported delivery of the CDP-hosted disclosure workshop in Warsaw, handling participant information flows and follow-up either side of the event
Standardised repeatable processes and controls across organisations of very different size, sector and geography, and tracked submission coverage against deadlines

experience.title: Product Manager / Sustainability Consultant (Contract)
bullets: Owned tender and proposal responses end to end, setting response strategy, section ownership and the submission timeline against hard external deadlines
Ran sprint cycles with engineers, writing user stories and acceptance criteria and resolving scope questions in flight
Reviewed closed bids with sales in structured win and loss sessions, then reset qualification and response tactics on what the outcome data showed

experience.title: Research Consultant
bullets: Chaired recurring meetings of a 53-member consortium spanning corporate, government and NGO mandates, setting agendas, facilitating between competing positions and carrying actions to closure
Issued member newsletters and policy updates tracking international and national regulatory developments across five countries
Convened speaker-led learning sessions with industry associations and policymakers, from programme design through to participant follow-up
Presented GRI Standards at the Bombay, Colombo and Dhaka stock exchanges, and evaluated 53 members' engagement with 17 SDGs across 5 countries
Established partnerships with corporates, governments and NGOs across South Asia, and documented GRI-BRSR linkage against national SEBI requirements

experience.title: Junior Architect
bullets: Managed a team of 4 from proposal to delivery, and advised on 15+ commercial, hospitality and institutional projects worth 20M+ euros
Consolidated specialist consultant inputs on air, noise, water and ecology into single regulatory submissions against permit deadlines, and briefed government authorities on a public-sector project
